text:
Hector Park: heads-up — found a reproducible duplicate-side-effect in the onboarding sample when a token rotate happens while the client is backing off from a 429. single click produced two webhook posts.

Mina Zhou: ouch. can you paste minimal repro steps?

Hector Park: yep: run sampleapp locally, click `confirm`, run `./scripts/rotate-creds.sh` after first 429 is returned, set ENV JITTER=0 for determinism. logs:
```
2026-03-27T15:02:01Z INFO req=rid1 status=429
2026-03-27T15:02:01Z INFO backoff_ms=120 jitter=0 req=rid1
2026-03-27T15:02:02Z WARN token rotated during backoff
2026-03-27T15:02:02Z INFO req=rid1 status=200 side_effect=applied
2026-03-27T15:02:03Z INFO req=rid1_retry status=200 side_effect=applied  <-- duplicate
```

Carlos Rivera: sounds like the resumed attempt dropped the Idempotency-Key. which SDK?

Hector Park: node-sdk v0.12.0 in the sampleapp. go and python in the matrix preserved it; node's resume path rebuilds headers post-refresh and misses it.

Mina Zhou: two quick mitigation ideas: (1) SDK change to persist Idempotency-Key (and optionally X-Correlation-Id) across token refresh/resume; (2) small server-side dedupe window. proposal default: safe_replay_window_ms=7000 (7s) — shorter than some proposals but big enough for token churn.

Carlos Rivera: +1. also make jitter=true by default for 429/backoff on SDKs. test harnesses can opt-out with JITTER=false. That avoids synchronized replays in prod.

Sam: for implementation: I'll open a node SDK PR that (a) stashes idempotency header into the retry context before auth refresh, (b) restores it on resume, and (c) adds unit + chaos e2e test `tests/chaos/token_rotate_429.test.js`.

Mina Zhou: nice. add a short-lived feature-flag in sampleapp `SAMPLEAPP_SAFE_REPLAY_MS` so we can A/B different defaults during canary. Also add a small quickstart note: "If your flow rotates tokens during in-flight requests, ensure Idempotency-Key survives refresh events."

Carlos Rivera: ops note: emit telemetry metric `sdk.replay.detected` with tag reason=token_rotate and sdk=node|python|go. we'll alert if duplicates per 1000 requests exceed threshold.

ci-bot: CI job queued: devex/sampleapp#chaos-token-rotate-429 (runs local auth flip + replay test)

Hector Park: pushed branch `devex/node-stash-idemp` and added `./scripts/run_replay_test.sh`. ping me if you can't reproduce.

Sam: PR opened: github.com/redwood/devex/node-sdk/pull/412 — tests included. leaving a TODO to run cross-sdk parity matrix once merged.

Mina Zhou: small docs decision: explicitly document which headers SDKs preserve by default (Idempotency-Key + X-Correlation-Id) and how to whitelist others. keeps semantics clear.

Carlos Rivera: agreed. after PR + sampleapp change let's run nightly chaos and evaluate telemetry for 2 weeks before tuning safe_replay_window_ms.

Hector Park: thanks everyone — will watch CI. :eyes:
